items.followUp: Write two advantages of an algorithm.

rubric.why: Writing an algorithm can require considerable time and effort.
rubric.description: Identifies that writing an algorithm is time consuming.
rubric.how: State that writing an algorithm takes time or is tedious.

rubric.why: Complex or lengthy algorithms may be difficult to follow.
rubric.description: Identifies that an algorithm can be difficult to understand.
rubric.how: State that an algorithm may be difficult or hard to understand.

modelAnswer: Writing an algorithm for a complex problem can be time consuming.
A lengthy or complex algorithm can be difficult to understand.
